description: Get administrative boundary metadata for a country from geoBoundaries: unit count, year represented, source, license, and download URLs for full GeoJSON (gjDownloadURL), simplified GeoJSON (simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON), TopoJSON (tjDownloadURL) and a static zip. ISO3 is the 3-letter country code (USA, FRA, KEN, IND). ADM level: ADM0=country, ADM1=state/province, ADM2=county/district, ADM3/ADM4=finer, ALL=every level. Default product gbOpen is CC-BY.

adm.description: Admin level: ADM0=country, ADM1=state/province, ADM2=county/district, ADM3, ADM4, or ALL.

product.description: Boundary product. gbOpen (default, CC-BY) | gbHumanitarian | gbAuthoritative.

name: get_boundaries
title: Get Boundaries
